create.name: Julie Ryan
create.bio:
Julie Ryan is an American psychic medium who hosts the Ask Julie Ryan show, a long-running YouTube and podcast series of conversations about spirit, angels, intuition and what happens at death. She spent a 45-year career in business, inventing and manufacturing surgical devices and founding nine companies, and learned energy work more than thirty years ago as a side interest that grew into her teaching. She describes herself as switching her abilities on only with permission and keeping what she learns confidential.

Her best-known idea is what she calls the Twelve Phases of Transition, an account of the angels, deceased relatives and pets she says gather around a dying person, set out in her book Angelic Attendants. She offers remote readings in which she speaks with deceased loved ones, and teaches a self-paced course on connecting with angels and higher guidance, reading signs and understanding the soul's passage beyond the body. She has also written the Angel Messages series of story collections and illustrated books for children. On her show she interviews mediums, researchers and teachers about near-death experiences, spirit contact and consciousness, and takes live questions from viewers.

books.title: Angelic Attendants: What Really Happens As We Transition From This Life Into The Next
books.author: Julie Ryan
books.description: Stories from families she has sat with, read from her perspective as a medium, describing the spirits, angels and departed pets she sees around the dying and the sequence of stages she calls the Twelve Phases of Transition.

books.title: Angel Messages for Your Life's Journey
books.author: Julie Ryan
books.description: A collection of first-hand accounts from graduates of her training of encounters with angels, God and departed loved ones.

books.title: Angel Messages for Kids
books.author: Julie Ryan
books.description: An illustrated picture book that answers children's big questions, including where babies come from and what happens at death, through gentle angel messages.

courses.title: Talk to Deceased
courses.description: A one-hour remote reading by phone in which she speaks with a deceased loved one on the client's behalf, passing on questions and asking for guidance.

courses.title: Angels and Enlightenment Training
courses.description: A self-paced online course on recognising and trusting guidance from angels, loved ones in spirit and higher consciousness, reading signs and symbols, and understanding her Twelve Phases of Transition at the end of life.

free_resources.title: Free digital copy of Angelic Attendants
free_resources.description: A request form for free ebook and audio copies of her book on what happens as people pass from this life, offered in English and Spanish.

sprint.held: Owner decision: half of her own pitch is medical intuition with strong claims in her own copy — her Medical Scanning page says she detects tumours, cancer, infections and heart issues 'sometimes before they're visible' on medical scans and that energetic healings up to the equivalent of 'a several-hour surgical procedure' follow; her About page and channel description open with sensing medical conditions, and her contact page offers a quick medical scan and healing to anyone unwell. Her mediumship, angel and afterlife work (show, books, Talk to Deceased, Angels and Enlightenment course) is clean and is all that this plan lists. Held so the owner can judge whether the medical pitch is her 'main pitch' (then drop) or one strand among several (then insert).
